title: Pre-Registered EFC Prediction: EG Statistic from SO × Euclid Cross-Correlation
abstract: This preregistration freezes an Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) prediction for the EG gravitational-slip statistic to be tested with the Simons Observatory (SO) CMB lensing cross-correlated with Euclid DR2 galaxy data. It specifies the predicted enhancement EG^EFC / EG^GR = 1.086 ± 0.012 at kc ≈ 0.05 h Mpc−1 and z ≈ 0.5, the dataset and estimator regime, and binding pass/fail (kill) criteria.
